content.short: Revert gives AMM liquidity providers analytics, automation and lending tools for their positions.
content.description: Revert Finance builds tools for liquidity providers on AMMs such as Uniswap: analytics for comparing pools and positions, automation for managing ranges, and lending against LP positions. It is widely used for checking how a concentrated-liquidity position has really performed after fees and impermanent loss. growthepie's contract labels show Revert activity on Unichain.
